data.one_liner: On-device background removal for iOS and Android using native vision and segmentation APIs.
data.what_it_does: Removes the background from a local image file entirely on-device, producing a transparent PNG. It uses the iOS Vision framework and Google Android ML Kit subject segmentation, supporting optional subject cropping and model download management.
use_when: You need to remove image backgrounds locally without external APIs or keys.
You target iOS 17+ and Android devices with Google Play services.
avoid_when: You need to run on older iOS versions below 17.0.
You require background removal to work on the iOS simulator.
strengths: Fully on-device processing with no external APIs or upload steps required.
Provides optional caching, in-memory bytes, and bounding box extraction.
Includes Android model download progress monitoring and lifecycle helpers.
weaknesses: iOS runtime processing requires iOS 17+ and a real device.
Android model requires an initial on-demand download via Google Play services.
data.setup_notes: No Podfile or AndroidManifest changes required. Android requires Google Play services for on-demand ML Kit model downloads.
